info.name: Art By Radhika - Backend APIs (with Cloudinary & 200MB Uploads)
info.description: Comprehensive Postman API collection for Art By Radhika Backend. Includes Authentication, Profile Completion, Address Management, Cloudinary File & Image Uploads (up to 200MB), Products with Images & Redis Caching, Complete Mehndi Booking Lifecycle with Reference Photos, and Redis/BullMQ Utilities.
